## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Cavern-Abyss Collection*

by [李思聰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E6%80%9D%E8%81%B0) (Lǐ Sīcōng) — Northern-Sòng Daoist

A Northern-Sòng Daoist **poetic-philosophical collection**, *c.* 1050. The Dào zàng preserves two anthologies under this title — this one by Lǐ Sīcōng, the other ([KR5d0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0087)) by Cháng quán zǐ 長筌子. Preserved as **DZ 1063** / CT 1063 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部).

**Dating.** *c.* 1050. Dynasty: 北宋.
